cards.title: Directives Overview
cards.content:
Directives

Directives are classes that add additional behavior to elements in your Angular applications.

cards.title: Structural Control Flow
cards.content:
Built-in Control Flow (Angular 17+)

Angular 17 introduced a new built-in control flow syntax: @if, @for, and @switch.

@if (isLoggedIn) {
  <p>Welcome!</p>
}

cards.title: Attribute Directives
cards.content:
Attribute Directives

These change the appearance or behavior of an element. Examples include ngClass and ngStyle.

<div [ngClass]="{'active': isActive}">...</div>

content.prompt: To dynamically apply multiple CSS classes based on conditions, you can use the [___] directive.
